newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore to publish telecoms tender notices Mar 1.
newsitem.headline: Singapore to publish telecoms tender notices Mar 1.

text.p: The Telecommunication Authority of Singapore (TAS) said on Friday it would publish a public tender notice on March 1 inviting pre-qualification for licences to offer basic telephone services in Singapore.
Singapore is due to open its telecoms market to competition from April 1, 2000.
TAS said in a statement up to two licences would be issued.
A shortlist of pre-qualified tenderers would be announced by September 1. These parties would then have five months to prepare full tender submissions.
